# package analyze

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-modbus-trace/analyze"
```

Package analyze holds streaming, bounded aggregators over a trace's events (REQUIREMENTS.md L11): Overview, Devices, Patterns and Coverage. Each is a trace.Sink, composed with Tee, keeps a documented cap and counts what the cap left out, and returns a JSON-able result.

## Constants

```go
const (
	MaxDevices          = 10_000
	MaxClientsPerDevice = 256
	MaxPatterns         = 10_000
	MaxIntervals        = 4_096  // per server, unit and data space
	MaxCoverageSpaces   = 40_000 // (server, unit, data space) keys of Coverage
)
```

Caps (ARCHITECTURE.md section 2).

## Functions

### func Tee

```go
func Tee(sinks ...trace.Sink) trace.Sink
```

Tee sends every event to every sink, in order; the first error stops.

### type Histogram

```go
type PatternResult struct {

}
```
